AboutCompanyTentangPerusahaan

PT Glory Tri Perkasa is a premier provider of contracting, general supply, maintenance and electrical services. Our range includes high-quality construction, reliable supply of materials and machinery, and expert electrical installation and maintenance.PT Glory Tri Perkasa menyediakan jasa kontraktor, general supply, perawatan, dan kelistrikan. Meliputi konstruksi berkualitas, pasokan material dan mesin yang andal, serta instalasi dan perawatan listrik.

Founded and led by industry veterans, we value integrity, innovation and sustainable practices, with tailored solutions for each client.Dipimpin oleh praktisi berpengalaman, kami mengutamakan integritas, inovasi, dan praktik berkelanjutan dengan solusi sesuai kebutuhan klien.
